steps.note: the API built this case's state
Withdraw the entire project through the project-level menu with a required reason.
Verify Procol records the project as withdrawn.
Open the technical stage to verify its withdrawn state.
Confirm the technical stage shows withdrawn.
Open the RFQ stage to verify its withdrawn state.
Confirm the RFQ stage shows withdrawn.
Open the History tab where withdrawn projects are listed.
Verify the withdrawn project appears in History.
Verify its History row has the Withdrawn status.
Open the invited vendor's supplier portal to verify vendor-facing withdrawal.
Open the event's technical stage in the vendor portal.
Confirm the vendor sees the technical stage as withdrawn.
Open the event's RFQ pricing stage in the vendor portal.
Confirm the vendor sees the RFQ stage as withdrawn.
